headline: No shared I/O or write surfaces are documented; the pair is low-risk overall, with only limited uncertainty around undocumented orchestration paths.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Dagster has no documented clipboard, stdin/stdout, filesystem read/write, MCP, or network bridge to godot_rl_agents, and the latter also exposes no shared channel. Without a communication path, prompt injection from one into the other is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies Dagster output into godot_rl_agents prompts, the risk becomes non-none.
IF either profile gains a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared prompt channel.
Disable any copy-paste or message-queue bridge between them.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if an orchestrator must pass outputs across agents.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent is documented to read or write files, and both show no network egress. Dagster touches no data classes, and godot_rl_agents also lists no data classes touched, so there is no documented path for sensitive data to flow between them.
conditions: IF Dagster is connected to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, reassess upward.
IF godot_rl_agents is given file-reading or network-egress capability, leakage risk changes.
mitigations: Keep sensitive data out of any shared workspace.
Review future permission changes before deployment.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Dagster cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, and godot_rl_agents has no documented write, git, or OAuth scopes. With no overlapping mutable resource, there is no capability conflict pathway in the documented profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is later granted write access to the same directory or repo, conflict risk becomes non-none.
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state, reassess for race conditions.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only in shared environments.
Avoid mounting the same writable directory into both agents.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared mutable state is introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Dagster is a data orchestrator, but the profile does not show it producing authoritative outputs for godot_rl_agents, and godot_rl_agents has no documented downstream action-taking authority. Without a documented handoff, there is no verified cascade from one agent's output into the other's actions.
conditions: IF an orchestrator feeds Dagster outputs directly into godot_rl_agents decisions, reassess upward.
IF godot_rl_agents is extended to act on Dagster-produced facts, cascading error risk increases.
mitigations: Insert a human or rule-based verification step between agents.
Log and review any cross-agent handoff payloads.
requires-engineering: add schema validation for exchanged outputs.

E_compliance.rationale: No data classes, residency constraints, certifications, or retention policies are documented for either agent, so there is no evidenced compliance mismatch between Dagster and godot_rl_agents. The absence of such fields prevents asserting a residency or retention violation.
conditions: IF either agent is assigned regulated data such as PHI or EU PII, reassess compliance.
IF future profiles document differing retention or residency rules, severity may rise.
mitigations: Do not route regulated data through either agent until policies are documented.
Record residency and retention requirements before deployment.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement if regulated data is introduced.
